name: CanvasOp
description:
Performs a primitive operation on the Otherside Design canvas surface.

Supported operations:
- `draw_rect`: add a rectangle node. Required: `x`, `y`, `w`, `h`, `fill`.
- `set_props`: update properties on an existing node. Required: `nodeId`, `props`.

Rules:
- `op` selects the operation and is always required.
- `w` and `h` must be greater than 0 when drawing a rectangle.
- `fill` must be a non-empty string when drawing a rectangle.
- The canvas surface is browser-side; this tool only enqueues the operation.
- Unsupported `op` values return a structured error with `op NOT_IMPLEMENTED`.

w.description: Width for `draw_rect`; must be greater than 0.

h.description: Height for `draw_rect`; must be greater than 0.

fill.description: Fill color for `draw_rect`; must be non-empty.
